title: Toward Holistic Evaluation of Recommender Systems Powered by Generative Models
reasoning: The paper proposes a holistic evaluation framework with 'Harmlessness' as one of its three core goals. It designates 'Bias & Fairness / Safety' and 'Alignment with Platform Policies' as key evaluation dimensions, and it explicitly discusses the need to assess ethical concerns such as cultural norms, societal impact, and brand-safe context as integral parts of the evaluation process.
